intro: Hum ek naya developer hai. Hum server hosting service ASHIKA Network aur Minecraft server list SABALISU chalaata hai, aur Minecraft server software Storia banaata hai.
about: Hum abhi naya hai, lekin roj code likhta hai aur aur accha hota jaata hai
Hum aapan khud ke server hosting service chalaata hai
Hamaar service ya technology ke baare me sawaal ke swaagat hai: Discord pe khaali hello bolo
can_write: Hum ka likh sake hai (gandaa code bhi milaike)
anw_t: ASHIKA Network: mahina ke 30 yen se server
anw_p:
Ek hosting service un logan ke khaatir jon server chalaana mangta hai lekin jaada paisa nahi kharch sake hai.
Chhota se suru karo, **khaali 30 yen mahina se**.
sab_p:
Aapan Minecraft server list me daalo aur saathe khele waala log khojo.
Server khoje waala player aur aapan server ke prachaar kare mange waala maalik, dono ke kaam aave hai.
storia_t: Storia: bada Minecraft server ke khaatir server software
storia_p: Minecraft 26.2 ke khaatir Folia pe banaa ek open-source fork. **Storia Cluster** se ek duniya ek saath kai server pe chal sake hai, aur player loading screen bina unke beech aa-jaa sake hai.
storia_points: **Storia Cluster**: kai server ek duniya baante hai, unke beech ke connection encrypted hai
**Standby relay**: dusra relay ek live copy rakhta hai aur pahila ke kho jaane pe kaam sambhaalta hai
**Linear format**: duniya disk ke karib aadha jagah leve hai
**RAM duniya**, **Tick Guard**, data baante ke khaatir plugin API, aur bahut kuch
